loss_accumulation_under_recursion.description: Registry for tracking the accumulation of information loss in recursive process systems.

accumulation_classes.name: monotone_bounded_loss
accumulation_classes.behavior: Loss increases with N but converges to a fixed structural limit.
accumulation_classes.condition: Stable fixed-point recursion with bounded dissipation.

accumulation_classes.name: monotone_divergent_loss
accumulation_classes.behavior: Information is erased linearly or exponentially with each iteration.

accumulation_classes.name: recursive_accumulation_loss
accumulation_classes.behavior: Loss scales with the complexity of branch generation.
